objects: Analyze this ARC-AGI-3 game-state image. Return only valid SWI-Prolog source code, with no Markdown fences and no prose. Describe each visible object with stable object IDs, bounding boxes, colors, geometry, containment, adjacency, and other useful properties. For each drawable object, also include a turtle_program(ObjectId, Program) fact using a list of Turtle DSL instructions such as penup, pendown, set_pos(X,Y), setcolor(Color), set_cell, fwd(N), and rot(Degrees). Rotations are relative. Keep coordinates explicit and preserve the rendered state exactly.
differences: Compare the previous and current ARC-AGI-3 states. Return only valid SWI-Prolog source code, without Markdown or prose. Write differences as facts and rules suitable for differences.pl. Include added_object/1, removed_object/1, changed_object/3, moved_object/4, recolored_object/3, resized_object/3, unchanged_object/2, action_effect/2, and any other useful predicates. Use the supplied objects.pl descriptions when available. Distinguish observation from hypothesis.
redraw: Return only valid SWI-Prolog source. Generate Turtle DSL facts that redraw the current ARC-AGI-3 image as faithfully as possible. Do not include Markdown or explanatory prose.
redraw_diff: Return only valid SWI-Prolog source. Generate a Turtle DSL patch which transforms the previous state into the current state using the smallest clear set of operations. Do not include Markdown or explanatory prose.
similarity: Return only valid SWI-Prolog source. Match similar objects between the previous and current ARC-AGI-3 states. Include object_match/3 facts with confidence, matching evidence, and unmatched objects. Do not include Markdown or explanatory prose.
